packages.title: Party Royale UI Kit
packages.description: A chunky, candy-coloured party-platformer interface — main menu, in-match HUD and a results board. Built entirely from reusable components: one Jelly Button, one Stat Pill and one Qualifier Row are instanced across all three screens, so restyling the button restyles every screen at once. Each instance differs only by its parameters and a tone class. Installs six live variables (Crowns, Kudos, PlayersLeft, RoundName, TimeLeft, Qualified) already bound to the HUD.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: RPG Combat HUD
packages.description: A full action-RPG HUD lifted from a shipped game: player and target frames, cast bar, boss bar, action bar, build palette, minimap, toasts and pickup popups. Its repeated widgets (build tiles, action buttons, key chips) ship as reusable components — edit one and every copy updates, or drop them into your own UI. Screen UI, hidden until you show it.
packages.author: TheDevRealm

packages.title: Arcade Racer HUD
packages.description: Arcade racing overlay from a shipped game — lap and timing readouts, boost and speed panels, menu chrome. Screen UI, hidden until you show it.
packages.author: TheDevRealm

packages.title: Starter Props
packages.description: Crates, a barrel and a stone block to dress a level with. Physics is switched on, so they tumble the moment you press Play.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Neon Signage Kit
packages.description: Emissive pillars and a hanging sign for night-time city scenes. Drops straight into a scene with bloom enabled.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Physics Playground
packages.description: A ramp, a launch platform and a heavy ball — a ready-made rig for testing collisions, mass and restitution.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Blade Prop
packages.description: A sword model you can place, parent to a character, or attach to a weapon socket. The mesh downloads separately, so the package itself stays tiny.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Sandbox World
packages.description: A ready-to-play starter world: a ground plane, a stack of physics crates and a lit sky. Creates a new project you can build on.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Arbor Forge — Stylized Tree Studio
packages.description: Turn the parametric tree system into an art department: twelve hand-tuned stylized presets — Sakura, Autumn Maple, Ghost Willow, Ancient Oak, Baobab, Savanna Acacia, Frost Spruce and more — with a live 3D preview, a seed explorer, one-click planting and natural grove scattering. Everything it plants is an ordinary tree asset: terrain-snapped, wind-animated, choppable, and still editable in the Tree Builder afterwards.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Model Forge — Prototype Modeler
packages.description: Prototype props without leaving the engine in a Blender-inspired Object, Edit and Paint workspace. Kit-bash five primitives, shape box control cages by vertex, edge or face, search twelve starter models, paint from a stylized palette, and choose smooth rounded or crisp flat finishes. Placed copies stay live-linked; finished props bake into real GLB assets for projects and exports.
packages.author: Feather

packages.title: Pixel Art Trees — Procedural Vegetation Studio
packages.description: Create game-ready pixel vegetation without importing sprites: nine procedural leaf languages, five growth habits, live 3D seed previews, custom palettes and one-click terrain-snapped groves. Every result is a tiny deterministic Feather tree recipe, so forests stay editable, wind-animated, choppable, collaboration-safe and ready for export.
packages.author: Feather

learning.goal: Watch Resonance, then remix its cameras, lighting and real physics cues.
learning.controls: Play watches the film · Replay film or R starts again · Stop returns to editing
lessons: Open Cinematic and select one of eight named camera shots.
Change the global wind to move all four cloth banners.
Tune the reactor material or Lux lighting in the scene.
Open Physics & replay cues to change the impulse or fracture timing; Play from the start to simulate it.

packages.title: Resonance
packages.description: A 32-second kinetic hall film: real domino collisions, wind-driven cloth, Lux lighting, a live reactor fracture and eight cinematic shots. Play, replay and edit every cue.
packages.author: Feather

learning.goal: Explore and modify the action starter with enemies and objectives.

Inspect enemy behavior in Logic.

Play through the objective and export.
